tagline: Structured Thinking For End-to-End Product Experience Building with AI
format: Live, not recorded. One worked example. Web research pre-cached (parallel-agent capability preserved).
core_question: What does this user need to succeed at this job? — asked with discipline across the chain.

modules.title: Idea + Scope Skeleton
modules.claudeCodeCapability: Sequential write — single agent fills a template

modules.title: Research Blitz
modules.skill: Get evidence before locking; borrow user language
subAgents: manthan-researcher (x3 parallel; Stream A reads pre-cached web research)
modules.output: User voice (pre-cached) + competitive scan + market context

modules.title: JTBD + 4 Archetypes
modules.skill: Translate research into user models that drive design

modules.title: User Need Map
modules.skill: Ask 'what does the user need to succeed?' with discipline — across 8 journey dimensions. Drives Module 4's candidate features.
modules.claudeCodeCapability: Sequential synthesis grounded in first-principles user-need derivation
modules.output: User Need Map — 8 dimensions × 2-3 specific needs each (~16-24 needs total)

modules.title: Pareto v1 Lock
modules.skill: Cut ruthlessly; every cut needs a trigger to revisit
modules.output: v1 lock + priority queue with triggers

modules.title: Direction Brief
modules.skill: Pin the directional feel + AI architecture before code
modules.output: Reference brief + 3 vectors + emotion + AI surface map

modules.title: Build Prototype (polished, home.html-quality)
modules.skill: Compound visual + structural constraints to produce a polished prototype; treat output quality as the credibility test
modules.claudeCodeCapability: Scaffold inheritance · parallel sub-agents per screen · iteration pass · multi-artifact audit
modules.output: Single-file HTML prototype (scaffold-inherited, theme-cued, reference-pattern-applied, voice-locked, iterated)

subAgents.name: manthan-researcher
subAgents.purpose: Parallel research — user voice / competitive scan / market context

subAgents.name: jtbd-synthesizer
subAgents.purpose: Convert research into JTBD grid + 4 archetypes

subAgents.name: scope-editor
subAgents.purpose: Apply 5-criteria Pareto test, return v1 lock + priority queue

subAgents.name: principle-auditor
subAgents.purpose: Layer 3 enforcement — audit any artifact against PRINCIPLES.md

enforcement.layer2_slashCommandPreamble: Every /manthan-N command opens with a verbatim 3-question check
enforcement.layer3_verifierSubAgent: principle-auditor runs after every artifact-production gate
enforcement.layer4_userPromptSubmitHook: settings.json injects principles reminder on every learner prompt
